name: Ingenuity flight paths and landing points
notes: From https://mars.nasa.gov/mmgis-maps/M20/Layers/json/m20_heli_flight_path.json and https://mars.nasa.gov/mmgis-maps/M20/Layers/json/m20_heli_waypoints.json. 72 flights, 18.139 km in all. The flight paths carry no heights: each leg is given the ground height of its landing point.
